ITEM 1 | Flatbread wedges, golden-brown with darker charred spots, topped with melted pale cheese and red sauce spots, two triangular pieces each roughly 8-10 cm long, slightly glossy surface, top-right of plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Sliced zucchini, bright green skin with paler green flesh, thin half-moon and wedge slices about 1 cm thick, lightly grilled with some darker grill marks and a sheen of oil, upper-left of plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Yellow squash slices, pale yellow to golden with slight browning at edges, half-moon pieces about 1 cm thick, glossy with oil, mixed among zucchini slices | 40
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream to off-white, bite-sized clusters about 2-3 cm across, matte and slightly moist, dry-looking surface, left-center of plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Grilled eggplant pieces, dark purple skin with browned, slightly soft cut faces, thick slices about 1.5 cm, center of plate near flatbread | 45
ITEM 6 | Red onion slices, deep purple rings, thin and slightly translucent, center-right of plate | 20
ITEM 7 | Grilled chicken or similar pale meat pieces, light tan with golden grill marks, chunks about 3-4 cm, slightly glossy, right-center of plate | 60
ITEM 8 | Mixed salad greens, dark and bright green arugula-like leaves, some wilted, dressed with a light sheen and yellow lemon-like strands, lower-right of plate | 60
ITEM 9 | Cherry tomato halves, glossy red with slightly wet cut surfaces and green stems, about 2 cm, scattered on greens | 35
ITEM 10 | Crumbled white cheese, off-white crumbles about 0.5-1 cm, dry and crumbly, scattered over salad and onions | 15
ITEM 11 | Dark olives, glossy black-purple halves and whole pieces about 1.5 cm, scattered on salad | 15
ITEM 12 | Dressing/oil, thin clear-to-yellowish sheen with flecks of lemon zest on greens and vegetables, light coating | 8
